entries.name: Big R
entries.look:
Big R is the Loyalists' heavy. The field tally writes Black Bear. The after-action writes ANCHOR. He boosts Embercap, misses twice in a row, then finishes a Koopa and carries Dewdrop's unconscious body while Embercap works the winch. Waluigi was not on that wall. The tally was. It names a Black Bear as the most-targeted body in the Junction wall, and it names Big R as ANCHOR in the same breath as a Magikoopa's attention. Waluigi is filing them as one person until a second hearing splits them.

## What the session proved

He climbed last in a four-person ladder order: Embercap, Dewdrop, Toadett

entries.name: Embercap
entries.look: Embercap is the Field Commander of the Peach Loyalists, the toad who leads assaults from the front while Captain Toadette plans them from behind. At Bramblehaven, his crimson plume cut through battlefield smoke like a wound, rallying troops as they scaled walls under fire. Waluigi respects field commanders who actually COMMAND from the field instead of sending others to die while they watch from safety. Embercap earns his title the hard way. Waluigi has written extensively about the Peach Loyalists and their methods, which Waluigi finds morally COMPLICATED. Captain Toadette's no-quarter policy

entries.name: Mistveil
entries.look: Mistveil is one of Captain Toadette's most effective intelligence operatives—a specialist in infiltration, extraction, and the acquisition of secrets that powerful people prefer to keep hidden. At Fawful's gala, Mistveil posed as a minor noble and extracted Chief Thornpaw's confirmation of his relationship with Princess Peach—testimony that validated decades of Loyalist theories. The conversation lasted approximately thirty minutes and produced more actionable intelligence than some operatives gather in years.
